title: Oil on Viewer
summary: A color-field painting whose every colour, contrast and motion is dictated live by the viewer's own operating-system settings, read but never stored or sent.
mechanism: matchMedia preference queries (prefers-color-scheme/contrast/reduced-motion/inverted-colors/forced-colors/color-gamut/dynamic-range) with live change events drive CSS custom properties and a Haacke-style real-time data plate; no controls, no storage, no network.
